annotation.title_clean: Using Virtual Reality for scenario-based Responsible Research and Innovation approach for Human Robot Co-production
annotation.title_en: Using Virtual Reality for scenario-based Responsible Research and Innovation approach for Human Robot Co-production
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Aschenbrenner, D.; Van Tol, D.; Rusak, Z.; Werker, C.
annotation.venue: 3rd IEEE International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Virtual Reality (AIVR 2020)
annotation.summary_en: Conference paper proposing virtual reality scenarios within a Responsible Research and Innovation approach to explore stakeholder reactions to robots collaborating closely with workers in Industry 4.0, aiming to design workspaces perceived as teamwork rather than a job threat.
key_provisions_or_claims: Use VR scenarios to elicit stakeholder reactions to human-robot co-production before deployment.
RRI requires investigating the thoughts and feelings of all stakeholders when introducing new technology.
Workers fear job redundancy from Industry 4.0 robots.
Successful human-robot interaction can raise productivity and well-being.
Design for a 'teamwork' perception instead of 'fear'.
